A compact inflatable foam pit option for kids' parties and backyard-style events. The pit is 13 ft × 13 ft with 3 ft side walls and a 6 ft back wall, creating a contained foam play area for kids to enjoy.

The foam pit is booked as part of our Kids Foam Party service — foam solution is included based on your booking, and pricing is confirmed with your foam party quote. It is outdoor use only and needs water access and power access at the setup area.

Adult supervision is required at all times, and weather and setup suitability are confirmed before every event.
